title: Podcast starter episode front matter
description: The front matter of an episode: a Markdown file under _posts/ with its audio and its place in the season.

audio.description: The audio file of the episode, as a path on this site.

audio_length.description: The size of the audio file in bytes, which the feed needs for the enclosure.

audio_type.description: The media type of the audio file, such as audio/mpeg.

author.description: The host of the episode: a key of _data/authors.yml.

description.description: One sentence about the episode, used in the feed and in link previews.

duration.description: How long the episode runs, in seconds.

explicit.description: Whether the episode has explicit content. Podcast directories ask for it.

layout.description: The layout that renders the episode: post.

number.description: The number of the episode in its season.

permalink.description: The address of the episode, such as /episodes/episode-1/.

published.description: false leaves the episode out of the build.

season.description: The season the episode belongs to.

tags.description: The topics of the episode, shown on the tags page.

title.description: The title of the episode, shown in the heading and in the feed.
